supports: Directions require a combination rule appropriate to the intended detail-addition operation.
Reorienting the flat reference toward the base gives a geometric interpretation for detail mapping.
sources.reading_scope: Article text and formulas read; no source images, video or demo execution. Other methods and historical instruction counts are not adopted as project evidence.
limitations: Neutral-input behavior is not full material correctness.
Specific implementation needs its own unit-length, antiparallel and representation handling.

original_example.inputs: Same tangent-coordinate convention; decoded unit base(3/5,0,4/5), flat detail(0,0,1).
original_example.encoding_case: For c=(n+1)/2 only, equal encoded average decodes to(3/10,0,9/10), giving the same normalized direction.
original_example.positive_geometric_condition: Choose R with Rf=b; when d=f, Rd=b. This condition alone does not uniquely specify general R or a complete RNM implementation.
